description: This file defines the SaleTax controller class within the OpenCart administration panel, responsible for handling sale tax reports, including generating, displaying, and saving report configurations.

classes.name: SaleTax
classes.description: Controller class for managing sale tax reports in OpenCart admin, including viewing, generating, and saving report configurations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the sale tax report page, loads language strings, sets up breadcrumbs, and renders the report form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report settings via AJAX, checking permissions, and returning success or error messages in JSON format.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the sale tax report page, including report data and filters.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the report list as AJAX response.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates the report data based on filter parameters, pagination, and renders the report view.
